articles.summary: MIAMI, July 01, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Laureate Education, Inc. (NASDAQ: LAUR) plans to release results for the quarter ended June 30, 2025, on Thursday, July 31, 2025, before the stock market opens. Following the release, the Company will host a conference call with investors and analysts at 8:30 a.m. ET to discuss the first quarter results and the Company's business outlook. Interested parties are invited to listen to the earnings conference call by registering here to receive dial in information. The webcast of the conference call, including replays, and a copy of the earnings release and the related slides will be made available through the Investor Relations section of the Company's website at www.laureate.net .
